from pathlib import Path
for key in ('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS'):os.environ[key]='1'
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm,logm
started=time.monotonic();source=Path(__file__).read_bytes();input_path=Path(sys.argv[1]);raw=input_path.read_bytes();cap=json.loads(raw)
expected='bd4d5e1d0e9fcfadef72cc9dba2cc4f7e6efacc6a577ee331fcd5b82574e5e49';assert cap['capsule']['source_sha256']==expected
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='centre-unitary-stat-') as directory:
    replay=Path(directory)
    for name,text in cap['capsule']['source_bytes_at_IMPORT'].items():
        assert Path(name).name==name and hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()==cap['capsule']['source_sha256_at_IMPORT'][name]
        (replay/name).write_text(text)
    sys.path.insert(0,str(replay))
    import covariant_root_transfer as root
    from covariant_induced_photon import Parameters,phi_frame
    edges=((0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(0,4),(4,5),(4,6),(4,7),(1,5));model=root.BosonicEdgeModel(8,edges)
    masks=sum((np.rint(np.diag(model.n(i)).real).astype(int)*(1<<i) for i in range(8)),np.zeros(model.dimension,dtype=int))
    Xstars=root.tensor_pauli(['X' if edge in ((0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(4,5),(4,6),(4,7)) else 'I' for edge in model.edges])
    adjacency={i:[] for i in range(8)}
    for a,b in edges[:-1]:adjacency[a].append(b);adjacency[b].append(a)
    def path(start,end):
        queue=[(start,)];seen={start}
        while queue:
            p=queue.pop(0)
            if p[-1]==end:return p
            for other in adjacency[p[-1]]:
                if other not in seen:seen.add(other);queue.append((*p,other))
        raise ArithmeticError('Disconnected native primitive graph')
    E={}
    for i,j in itertools.product(range(8),repeat=2):E[i,j]=model.n(i) if i==j else model.bilinear(i,j,path=path(j,i))
    graph={m:[] for m in range(256)};pattern_error=0.
    for i,j in itertools.product(range(8),repeat=2):
        actual=Xstars@E[i,j]@Xstars # UNITARY: no coefficient conjugation
        target=(model.identity if i==j else 0)-E[j,i]
        pattern_error=max(pattern_error,float(np.linalg.norm((abs(actual)>1e-10).astype(int)-(abs(target)>1e-10).astype(int))))
        for row,col in np.argwhere(abs(actual)>1e-10):graph[int(masks[col])].append((int(masks[row]),target[row,col]/actual[row,col]))
    assert pattern_error==0
    phase={};consistency=0.
    for seed in range(256):
        if seed in phase:continue
        phase[seed]=1.+0j;queue=[seed]
        while queue:
            old=queue.pop()
            for new,ratio in graph[old]:
                desired=ratio*phase[old]
                if new in phase:consistency=max(consistency,abs(phase[new]-desired))
                else:phase[new]=desired;queue.append(new)
    assert consistency<1e-12
    PH=np.diag([phase[int(m)] for m in masks])@Xstars
    all64=max(float(np.linalg.norm(PH@E[i,j]@PH.conj().T-((model.identity if i==j else 0)-E[j,i]))) for i,j in E)
    direct=model.bilinear(1,5,path=(5,1));reverse=model.bilinear(5,1,path=(1,5))
    direct_error=float(np.linalg.norm(PH@direct@PH.conj().T+reverse))
    gamma,_=phi_frame(Parameters());_,basis=np.linalg.eigh(gamma[0]);frame=np.column_stack((basis[:,2:],basis[:,:2]));gb=np.array([frame.conj().T@g@frame for g in gamma])
    constraints=np.vstack([np.kron(g.conj().T,np.eye(4))-np.kron(np.eye(4),g) for g in gb]);_,_,vh=np.linalg.svd(constraints,full_matrices=False)
    UT=vh[-1].conj().reshape(4,4,order='F');UT*=2/np.linalg.norm(UT);UT*=np.exp(-.25j*np.angle(np.linalg.det(UT)))
    UT_error=max(float(np.linalg.norm(UT@g.conj()@UT.conj().T-g)) for g in gb)
    assert UT_error<1e-12 and np.linalg.norm(UT@UT.conj()+np.eye(4))<1e-12
    R=-1j*gb[1]@gb[2]@gb[3];CH=R@UT
    generator=root.native_lift(model,logm(CH))+root.native_lift(model,logm(CH),4)
    GCH=expm(generator);C=GCH@PH
    P0=-model.A(0,1)@model.path_A((2,0,3))
    P1=-model.A(4,5)@model.path_A((6,4,7))
    PHpauli=P0@P1
    pauli_all64=max(float(np.linalg.norm(PHpauli@E[i,j]@PHpauli.conj().T-((model.identity if i==j else 0)-E[j,i]))) for i,j in E)
    pauli_direct=float(np.linalg.norm(PHpauli@direct@PHpauli.conj().T+reverse))
    Cpauli=GCH@PHpauli
    assert pauli_all64<1e-11 and pauli_direct<1e-11 and np.linalg.norm(PHpauli@PHpauli.conj().T-model.identity)<1e-11
    external=[]
    for index,edge in enumerate(model.edges):
        if edge not in ((0,4),(1,5)):continue
        word=['I']*len(model.edges);word[index]='Z';Z=root.tensor_pauli(word)
        external.append(dict(edge=edge,actual_UNITARY_C_Z_Cdag_error=float(np.linalg.norm(C@Z@C.conj().T-Z)),
            actual_Pauli_QUARTIC_UNITARY_C_Z_Cdag_error=float(np.linalg.norm(Cpauli@Z@Cpauli.conj().T-Z))))
    cycles=[]
    for vertices,S in zip(model.cycles,model.stabilizers):
        cycles.append(dict(vertices=vertices,length=len(vertices),S_imaginary_matrix_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(S.imag)),
            K_S_K_minus_S_error=float(np.linalg.norm(S.conj()-S)),
            actual_UNITARY_C_S_Cdag_error=float(np.linalg.norm(C@S@C.conj().T-S)),
            PH_unitary_S_error=float(np.linalg.norm(PH@S@PH.conj().T-S)),
            Gamma_RUT_S_error=float(np.linalg.norm(GCH@S@GCH.conj().T-S))))
        cycles[-1]['actual_Pauli_QUARTIC_UNITARY_C_S_Cdag_error']=float(np.linalg.norm(Cpauli@S@Cpauli.conj().T-S))
    odd=root.BosonicEdgeModel(3,((0,1),(0,2),(1,2)));oddS=odd.stabilizers[0]
    odd_control=dict(length=len(odd.cycles[0]),K_S_K_minus_S_error=float(np.linalg.norm(oddS.conj()-oddS)),K_S_K_plus_S_error=float(np.linalg.norm(oddS.conj()+oddS)))
    odd4=root.BosonicEdgeModel(4,((0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(1,2)))
    odd4S=odd4.stabilizers[0];odd4PH=-odd4.A(0,1)@odd4.path_A((2,0,3))
    odd4C=expm(root.native_lift(odd4,logm(CH)))@odd4PH
    odd4_control=dict(length=len(odd4.cycles[0]),K_S_K_minus_S_error=float(np.linalg.norm(odd4S.conj()-odd4S)),
        actual_Pauli_QUARTIC_UNITARY_C_S_Cdag_error=float(np.linalg.norm(odd4C@odd4S@odd4C.conj().T-odd4S)))
    assert odd4_control['K_S_K_minus_S_error']>1 and odd4_control['actual_Pauli_QUARTIC_UNITARY_C_S_Cdag_error']<1e-11
    assert all64<1e-11 and direct_error<1e-11 and max(r['actual_UNITARY_C_Z_Cdag_error'] for r in external)<1e-11
    assert max(r['actual_UNITARY_C_S_Cdag_error'] for r in cycles)<1e-11 and all(r['K_S_K_minus_S_error']==0 for r in cycles)
    assert max(r['actual_Pauli_QUARTIC_UNITARY_C_S_Cdag_error'] for r in cycles)<1e-11
    assert max(r['actual_Pauli_QUARTIC_UNITARY_C_Z_Cdag_error'] for r in external)<1e-11
    assert odd_control['K_S_K_minus_S_error']>1 and odd_control['K_S_K_plus_S_error']==0
    result=dict(source_bytes=source.decode(),source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
        input=dict(path=str(input_path),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),frozen_root_sha256=expected),
        runtime=dict(executable=sys.executable,python=sys.version,numpy=np.__version__),
        graph='Actual8-edge/256dim primitive graph with TWO4-modeBODYfibres; no independently seeded local PH product; all64 primitive global phase constraints and direct physical chord used.',
        actual_GLOBAL_UNITARY_PH_all64_matrixunit_error=all64,actual_UNITARY_PH_direct_spatial_chord_error=direct_error,
        UT_gamma_intertwiner_error=UT_error,all_physical_spatial_Dstat_Z_controls=external,
        actual_UNITARY_statistical_cycle_controls=cycles,actual_odd_cycle_reality_negative_control=odd_control,
        explicit_Pauli_QUARTIC_PH_all64_error=pauli_all64,explicit_Pauli_QUARTIC_PH_direct_chord_error=pauli_direct,
        explicit_Pauli_QUARTIC_PH_formula='P_site=-A(anchor,1) path_A((2,anchor,3)), with corresponding onsite labels; product over all FOUR-mode BODY fibres. Actual even Majorana quartic, no occupation isometry or local-sector phase seeding.',
        actual_odd4_cycle_UNITARY_C_control=odd4_control,
        universal_UNITARY_statistical_proof='S_C is central in the primitive A_e/B_i even algebra: for any A_f the number of anticommuting cycle edges is even, and for B_v the closed cycle has exactly two incident edges. Thus every A_e, B_i and every path_A commutes S_C. P_site is an explicit product of A/path_A and Gamma(RUT) is generated by onsite even matrix units made from A/B. UNITARY C therefore commutes EVERY S_C, for EVEN OR ODD cycles. Coordinate inversion acts only on continuous fields. No K-reality or bipartite hypothesis is required for this explicit Pauli-quartic UNITARY route.',
        unitary_PH_phase_table={str(k):dict(real=v.real,imag=v.imag) for k,v in phase.items()},
        exact_even_cycle_reality_proof='primitive_pauli_words assigns one X to its own edge and only Z to other incident edges, so each A_e matrix is REAL. cycle_operator is i^ell product A_e, therefore S is REAL exactly for even ell. Every cycle of a bipartite graph is even; alternatively a complete even-length cycle-space generating set proves even parity for every cycle. This is a geometry proof requirement, not a consequence of real Z2 toron eigenvalues.',
        ideal_Dstat_support='The UNITARY PH phase is occupation-diagonal times X on onsite T-joins; Gamma(RUT) is built from actual onsite even matrix units. External/spatial edges enter only through Z factors, so ALL physical spatial Z_e commute. Field coordinate inversion acts on continuous Haar coordinates, not these Pauli edges.',
        scope='DIRECT UNITARY C S Cdag and C Z Cdag executed with global phase solve AND explicit physical Pauli quartic. Native even cycle and an actual ODD4mode cycle both preserve S, although odd-cycle K reality fails. Universal central-algebra argument establishes all-cycle UNITARY preservation. No fullPhi/outside or SAME source CP certificate.',
        elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(output=sys.argv[2],source_sha256=result['source_sha256'],global_UNITARY_PH_error=all64,
        direct_spatial_error=direct_error,UNITARY_S_error=max(r['actual_UNITARY_C_S_Cdag_error'] for r in cycles),
